title: Belief Embedding Tree Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.15046v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Beliefs in a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) are posterior distributions over the hidden state given the agent's history of actions and observations. They summarize everything the history says about the state, so planning in a POMDP is planning in a Markov decision process (MDP) over beliefs. Belief MDPs have continuous state spaces even for finite POMDPs, and exact planning in them is intractable in general. Planners must therefore approximate beliefs and estimate values. Monte Carlo planners do both inside a search tree, with an approximate belief at every node and a value estimate at every leaf. Approximations usually consist of sets of sampled states, with leaf values coming from rollouts, hand-designed bounds, or learned networks. translated_abstract: 部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）中的信念，是在给定智能体动作与观测历史的条件下关于隐藏状态的后验分布。信念总结了历史中关于状态的全部信息，因此在POMDP中规划等价于在信念空间上的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中进行规划。即使对于有限的POMDP，信念MDP也具有连续的状态空间，对其进行精确规划通常是难以处理的。因此，规划器必须近似信念并估计价值。蒙特卡洛规划器在搜索树内部同时完成这两项任务：每个节点维护一个近似信念，每个叶节点给出一个价值估计。这些近似通常由采样状态集合构成，叶节点的价值则来自模拟推演（rollout）、手工设计的界或学习得到的网络。由这些近似计算出的策略与价值受限于它们本身的质量，而先前基于学习网络的方法依赖于对手工选择的采样状态摘要表示。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出用神经网络学习的信念嵌入来表示搜索树中各节点的近似信念，取代以往对手工选择的状态摘要的依赖，从而提升POMDP蒙特卡洛树搜索中策略与价值估计的质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Belief Embedding Tree Search, which uses learned neural network embeddings to represent approximate beliefs at each search-tree node, replacing hand-crafted summaries of sampled states and improving policy and value estimates in POMDP Monte Carlo planning.
